verdict.rationale: Render documents its own way to run background work: you can deploy agents and background processes without wiring up queues, workers or retry logic, and its Workflows SDKs let you define tasks and trigger runs from code. The evidence is marketing-level and shows only programmatic, one-off triggering, not recurring schedules or event-driven automation set up within Render. Missing for 10: documented cron or recurring schedules, event-based triggers for automations, in-depth docs on autonomous run behavior, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can set up automations that run autonomously in the background
